IMPLEMENTATION SPEC · 15 SEPTEMBER 2026 · ALL SLICES PENDING

One landscape language.
Campaign and battle.

Connected ranges, grass-covered foothills, grounded forests and coherent water. Battle matches the location's character. The current spike proves a direction; it remains below the reference's quality.
